.rad input:checked + span { background: var(--ink); color: var(--bg); border-color: var(--ink); }
.rad input:focus-visible + span { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; }

.rad span { border: 1px solid var(--line-2); background: var(--bg); padding: 6px 13px; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-2); cursor: pointer; display: block; text-align: center; }

.seg button { border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; margin-bottom: -1px; background: transparent; padding: 8px 2px 9px; border-radius: 0; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-2); cursor: pointer; display: block; text-align: center; }
.seg button, .seg2 button { border: 0; margin: 0; border-radius: 99px; padding: 6px 16px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-2); background: transparent; cursor: pointer; }
.seg button.on, .seg2 button.on { background: var(--bg); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(18, 18, 20, .14); border: 0; }
.seg { display: inline-flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px 22px; padding: 0; background: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-2); }
.seg, .seg2 { display: inline-flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 2px; padding: 4px; background: var(--track); border: 0; border-radius: 99px; }
.seg.wide.seg4 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 6px; border-bottom: 0; }
